status_note: The 72-record datatype-layer projection matches the locked oracle. Six TypeFactory construction/wiring records are declared mismatches, and broader compare matrices remain explicitly untested; module status stays L2.

decisive_semantics.reference_and_output_parameters: Datatype/field/pointee/parent/stripped/prototype identities remain shared references; dependency comparisons use raw Ghidra pointer identity versus Arc identity predicates without serializing addresses.
decisive_semantics.loop_boundaries_and_iteration_order: Struct/union fields and enum values retain declared/container order; recursive compare decrements level exactly once per component edge and stops only when level becomes negative.
decisive_semantics.counters_accumulators_and_scope: Comparison level is caller-scoped, id fallback occurs after the decrement, and no counter is reset per field; fixture sign normalization never changes equality or traversal state.
decisive_semantics.sorting_and_comparison_keys: Keys follow submeta, descending size, subtype-specific wordsize/space/field/prototype keys, and id only at the recursion boundary; TypeFactory residuals are excluded from MATCH rather than normalized away.

assets.source_policy: Materialized from the pinned Rugra base commit by git archive

analysis_options.normalization: Comparison results are reduced to sign only; raw allocation addresses are never serialized. Dependency pointer/space ordering is observed only as equality/non-equality and forward/reverse antisymmetry. Six pinned TypeFactory gaps are compared as declared MISMATCH records.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and traversal order are fixed

identity: different object with same metatype/size and different name
